title: Dwi Hartono: Kacab Bank Scandal & New Revelations
text:
Bank Executive’s Murder Unveils Shocking Identity of Mastermind: Online Tutoring Entrepreneur Dwi Hartono The brutal kidnapping and murder of Mohamad Ilham Pradipta , head of a bank branch in Jakarta, has taken a startling turn with the arrest of Dwi Hartono, a prosperous online tutoring entrepreneur, identified as the intellectual author of the crime. Pradipta, 37, was found dead on Thursday, August 21, 2025, in a bush in Serang Baru, Bekasi Regency, his body bound with duct tape, revealing a meticulously planned abduction that began in a Pasar Rebo supermarket parking lot the previous day.
Escalating Investigation Leads to 15 Arrests
A joint team from Jatanras and Resmob Subdit Ditreskrimum Metro Jaya has secured a total of 15 suspects in connection with the case, steadily closing in on those responsible for Pradipta’s death. the investigation culminated in the capture of Hartono, a revelation that has sent shockwaves through the community. “DH is one of the kidnapping intellectual actors,” stated kombes Ade Ary, Head of Public Relations for the Metro Jaya Police, on Tuesday, August 26, 2025. while the motive remains under investigation, authorities believe Hartono orchestrated the kidnapping and subsequent murder.
UGM Deactivates Hartono Amidst Legal Proceedings
Gadjah Mada University (UGM) has officially deactivated Dwi Hartono from all academic activities. Dr. I Made Andi Arsana, a UGM spokesperson, confirmed the decision on Wednesday, August 27, 2025, citing support for the ongoing legal process. “The person concerned has been deactivated from all academic activities in the odd semester 2025/2026 as a form of UGM support for the ongoing legal process and investigation,” Arsana stated. Hartono was a frist-semester student in the Master of Management program at UGM’s Faculty of Economics and Business. UGM affirmed its commitment to upholding the principle of presumption of innocence while cooperating fully with the investigation.
A Glimpse into Hartono’s Lifestyle: Luxury Home and Quiet Existence Authorities have focused attention on Hartono’s residence in Gunung Putri,Bogor Regency. A visit to the property on wednesday,August 27,2025,revealed a two-story house,painted white and largely unoccupied. The property includes two adjacent houses, identified as Q8 and Q9, with the latter displaying a sign reading “Clan Hartono.” The balcony of house Q8 features the logo of “My Teacher,” Hartono’s online tutoring business, while “WD Fashion” is displayed above the garage. The house is situated on a busy street, yet neighbors report rarely seeing Hartono.
Neighbors express Shock and Reveal Limited Interaction The arrest of Hartono has left his neighbors in disbelief. Rudi, a resident of the Gunung Putri housing estate, stated, “I was shocked when I saw on Instagram.” He admitted to being unaware of Hartono’s presence, noting that he had never encountered him during his year living in the complex. “I don’t know, I don’t know, never come out [Hartono], we have never seen the person here for almost a year. Just found out that there were those cases, it turned out that the house was Q9.” Rudi also mentioned occasional deliveries of rice boxes from Hartono’s household assistant on Fridays, but no direct interaction with the suspect himself.
Past Legal Troubles: A 2012 Diploma Forgery case Further investigation has revealed a prior legal entanglement for Dwi Hartono. AKBP Andika Darma Sena, Kasat Reskrim Polrestabes Semarang, confirmed that Hartono was convicted in 2012 for falsifying a high school diploma. “Yes, it is indeed true that in 2012 related to falsification of high school diplomas, package C if I’m not mistaken,” Andika stated on Wednesday, August 27, 2025. Hartono received a two-year prison sentence for the offense, acting as the perpetrator who conditioned the forgery.
The investigation into the murder of Mohamad Ilham Pradipta continues, with authorities focused on uncovering the full extent of Dwi Hartono’s involvement and the motive behind this shocking crime.
